how: Chrome over its DevTools port (cdp.mjs) on a copy of a warm profile, Local State dns_over_https secure with the bench resolver as its template; echbench (net-fp-server captures/review-20261023/bench/ech): DoH answering A 127.0.0.1, no AAAA, HTTPS records (alpn h2, TargetName the name itself) per name; TLS servers keeping each ClientHello and opening the inner one with the bench's HPKE keys; each scenario a fresh Chrome, 5 s after start; two cohorts. {E} is the ech listener (keys of good, pad, chacha, p384, p256; good sent as retry configs), {P} one with no ECH key, {H} ech's keys with P-256 alone (HelloRetryRequest), {L} one whose key does not open its config, sent as retry configs.
